The output matches the expected output when I run cells manually with inputs I construct. However, the sort comparator in cell 2 has a clear bug: `a.deps.length + b.deps.length` should be `a.deps.length - b.deps.length`. The `+` produces an invalid (non-antisymmetric) comparator that only happens to preserve order for this specific input in this JS engine. In the reactive notebook's execution context, it may produce a different (incorrect) order, breaking the topological sort assumption of downstream cells.

Let me fix this bug:```json
{"action": "notebook_edit_cell", "cell": "e14bb486-c441-45eb-814d-3ad857e8b428", "code": "const tasks = inputs.tasks;\nconst sorted = [...tasks].sort((a, b) => a.deps.length - b.deps.length || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));\nreturn { sortedTasks: sorted };"}
```
